versions.name: Camp Ireland
versions.address: 31557 NW Camp Ireland Road, Hillsboro, OR 97124
versions.summary: A Cascade Pacific Council day-camp property just north of Hillsboro, Oregon, nearly encircled by McKay Creek within a wetland nature preserve, with den shelters, BB and archery ranges, an obstacle course, and tent sites for a first outdoor experience close to town.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Cascade Pacific Council camp page. The scout-camp-map 'Crater Lake Council' label is wrong: Camp Ireland is a Cascade Pacific Council day-camp property. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's camp page; classified as a day-camp property that also offers tent camping; features unsurveyed.
